test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 10.
solution: The correct answer is 'from.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • We use** from** to refer to the place where someone or something starts or originates: • **Example**:* We get our vegetables **from** the farm shop.* • We use** of **when we want to show that people or things relate to other things or people. • **Example**: *Tiffany stared at the floor **of** her room.* • We use for to talk about a purpose or a reason for something. • Example: *I’m going for some breakfast. I’m really hungry.* • You can use 'with' when you're talking about people, or things being together.*​* • Example: *She arrived with her boyfriend.* • Therefore, the preposition 'from' should be used to make the sentence grammatically correct. • Hence, the correct answer is 'from.' • *​​*Correct sentence__: *She ran into fierce resistance** from** academics and professionals at first who said ‘Dogs spread disease’.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • A preposition is a word or group of words used before a noun, pronoun, or noun phrase to show direction, time, place, location, spatial relationships, or to introduce an object. • Some examples of prepositions are words like *"in," "at," "on," "of," and "to."* • Example: *I live in Raipur.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • हम **from** का उपयोग उस स्थान को संदर्भित करने के लिए करते हैं जहां कोई या कुछ शुरू होता है या उत्पन्न होता है। • Example:* We get our vegetables from the farm shop.* • हम **of **का उपयोग तब करते हैं जब हम यह दिखाना चाहते हैं कि लोग या चीजें अन्य चीजों या लोगों से संबंधित हैं। • Example: *Tiffany stared at the floor of her room.* • हम किसी उद्देश्य या किसी कारण के बारे में बात करने के लिए preposition for उपयोग करते हैं। • Example: *I’m going for some breakfast. I’m really hungry.* • जब आप लोगों या चीजों के एक साथ होने की बात कर रहे हों तो आप 'with' का उपयोग कर सकते हैं • Example: *She arrived with her boyfriend.* • इसलिए वाक्य को व्याकरणिक रूप से शुद्ध करने के लिए preposition 'from' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। 5b:T1557, The correct answer is** 'It gives a comprehensive account of the life in the Malabar region.'**
